top_signals.title: Emerging-Market Assets Climb as Fed Hike Bets Cool, Oil Drops
top_signals.summary: Emerging-market stocks and currencies advanced after softer-than-expected US jobs data and a further decline in oil prices helped ease concern over aggressive interest-rate hikes by the Federal Reserve.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Surging Treasury yields don’t signal a U.S. 'fiscal apocalypse' — yet
top_signals.summary: Treasury yields above 5% are raising fears that higher borrowing costs could fuel a debt spiral.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Daryz races to second straight Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe crown
top_signals.summary: Daryz is the first two-time winner since Enable in 2017 and 2018 and first colt to achieve the feat since Alleged almost half a century ago.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
